limitations: The proxy records application protocol semantics; it is not a direct measurement of the original upstream TLS or HTTP/2 fingerprint.
Newly observed fields, endpoints, or metric names do not alone prove they were introduced in this release.
Fresh isolated profile, copied existing authentication, explicit bundled CLI selection, and enabled remote debugging differ from the normal installed app launch.
